So for this initial portfolio piece I wanted to look at a general IMDB dataset and run some basic data anaylyses before looking at my own personal IMDb watchlist to see some unique data! Hopefully not too ugly for a first portfolio...

```{r open_packages}

# Load the libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2movies)

```

```{r initial_peak}

# Load the dataset
data("movies")

# View the first few rows
head(movies)

# Check rough structure of dataset
glimpse(movies)

```

```{r data_clean}

# Select columns we want and remove NA's
movies_clean <- movies %>%
  select(title, year, length, rating, votes, mpaa, Action, Drama, Comedy) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rating), !is.na(votes))

# View summary of cleaned dataset
summary(movies_clean)

```

```{r first_visual}

ggplot(movies_clean, aes(x = rating)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of IMDb Ratings", x = "IMDb Rating", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r popular_movies}


# Set the minimum number of votes
min_votes <- 1000

# Filter movies with at least min_votes
popular_movies <- movies %>%
  filter(votes >= min_votes)

# Get the top 10 highest-rated movies
top_rated_movies <- popular_movies %>%
  arrange(desc(rating)) %>%
  select(title, year, rating, votes) %>%
  head(20)

# Display the top 10 movies
top_rated_movies


```

```{r second_visual}

# Create a bar plot of the top 10 highest-rated movies
ggplot(top_rated_movies, aes(x = reorder(title, rating), y = rating)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Highest-Rated Movies",
       x = "Movie Title",
       y = "Average IMDb Rating") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r my_watchlist}

library(tidyverse)

# I exported my IMDB watch list as a csv file
watchlist <- read_csv("C:/Users/jamie/Documents/GitHub/Portfolio-1/My Watchlist.csv")

# View the first few rows
head(watchlist)
glimpse(watchlist)

```

```{r comparison}

ggplot(watchlist, aes(x = `IMDb Rating`, y = `Your Rating`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +  
  labs(title = "My Ratings vs. IMDb Ratings",
       x = "IMDb Rating", y = "Your Rating") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r where_we_disagree}

# Create "outliers" 
outliers <- watchlist %>%
  mutate(Difference = `Your Rating` - `IMDb Rating`)

top_outliers <- outliers %>% 
  slice_max(abs(Difference), n = 30)  # Get top 30 biggest differences to look orderly

ggplot(top_outliers, aes(x = reorder(Title, Difference), y = Difference, fill = Difference > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 30 Movies We Disagree On",
       x = "Title",
       y = "Difference (Your Rating - IMDb Rating)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "blue"), labels = c("Lower Than IMDb", "Higher Than IMDb")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))


```
